subject.title: fix(agents): cloud thinking models time out at 120s during reasoning (#80349) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw accept disabling the implicit 120s cloud idle watchdog for non-off thinking models once this branch is rebased and proof requirements are handled?
rationale: The code shape is a narrow bug fix, but it changes default liveness behavior for existing cloud thinking model users and source-level proof has not yet shown a completed live Gemini turn after the fix.

options.title: Require Current-Base Proof
options.body: Ask for a rebase plus redacted live Gemini embedded-run logs, terminal output, or recording showing a non-off thinking turn no longer fails around 125s before merge.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Maintain the patch with source-level resolver proof only and explicitly own the longer-silence default risk for cloud thinking models.

options.title: Reject Or Narrow The Default Change
options.body: Do not merge this shape until a narrower timeout policy or separate maintainer-approved provider behavior is chosen.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Base Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase plus redacted live Gemini embedded-run logs, terminal output, or recording showing a non-off thinking turn no longer fails around 125s before merge.
